question.text: As per SEBI's June 21, 2023 circular, units representing unit capital held by investors in Chambal Managed Futures Fund must be issued in which mode?

answer.text: Only in physical certificate form, to preserve the 'trust indenture' bilateralism.
Either demat or physical at the investor's option, as stated in the Subscription Agreement.
In demat mode only for FPIs; resident investors may opt for physical.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 9.4 (footnote to SEBI circular SEBI/HO/AFD/PoD1/CIR/2023/96 dated June 21, 2023) requires that units of the AIF be issued in dematerialised mode only. Unit statements flow from the depository to the investor periodically — a compliance measure to protect investor interest. **The Trap:** Options A, B, D carry pre-2023 intuition where physical was permitted. Many managers migrated only on the stated deadlines, so the 'optional' trap tempts candidates who saw older PPMs. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests demat mandate across both tracks. XIX-B Cat III Distributor asks about the DP account opening flow for clients — same underlying rule. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** For a Cat III with multiple unit classes (series-of-units on daily NAV equalisation), coordinate ISIN creation with NSDL/CDSL BEFORE first subscription close — issuing post-facto ISINs for back-dated series creates equalisation-credit reconciliation headaches.
